$comment: Pins the SDK feature band so this repository builds identically on a developer machine, on a CI runner, and inside the SDK container image. The version is the MINIMUM required band, not the exact build: rollForward 'latestFeature' accepts any 10.0.x at or above 10.0.100. Pinning an exact high band (10.0.400) would break every environment sitting on a lower one, which is a self-inflicted CI failure with no upside.
